note: Countries that do not tax individuals' salaries, each with an official statement checked on verifiedOn.

countries.name: United Arab Emirates
countries.statement: The UAE does not levy income tax on individuals, so salaries are not taxed.
countries.quote: The UAE does not levy income tax on individuals.

countries.name: Saudi Arabia
countries.statement: Residents of Saudi Arabia are not subject to personal income tax, so salaries are not taxed. Saudi income tax applies to non-Saudi residents who carry on a business activity in the Kingdom, not to employment.
countries.quote: Residents in Saudi Arabia are not subject to personal income tax

source.name: Ministry of Investment of Saudi Arabia (MISA): Regional Headquarters programme

countries.name: Qatar
countries.statement: Individuals in Qatar do not pay personal income tax on salaries or wages.
countries.quote: Individuals do not pay personal income tax on salaries, wages, or personal income.
